claim_legs.durability: Exact Git-bound inputs, prospective source pins and complete first-run copies are tracked. Saved-only audit/recovery pass without raw-log access or fixture replay. Book, Knowledge Map, task and exact acceptance history preserve outcomes and the next frontier.
claim_legs.falsify: Unchanged recursive and independent interval/source-scope oracles agree with current rows. Prospectively bound original setup and the exact row adaptation preserve the original last-state oracle, which reconstructs final references and image custody. Altered rows, domains, headers, predictions, recovery and book counts reject.
claim_legs.rederive: Pinned recipes and immutable last-observation records distinguish actual reads/closes and release effects from reported errors and controlled setup. Original reference/image snapshots, TAP and the independent book watcher recount the observed domain.

commit_gate: Required staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Bounded composition join, complete close-report join, genuine omissions, final release, native/lifetime and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain open.
scope: Last-observation inert file-fixture compositions only. Qualified pure binding, real-close-first reporting, directory-read reporting and independent trace oracles remain unchanged. The original controlled setup retires the runtime and removes the other observation hold before the observed release. Final-hold unlink/absence truth and the exact unreferenced image remain independent. No prior fixture, other-profile fixture, producer/main, compiler or native process is replayed.
